You will hear Eva telling Dad about a school visit.
Dad: Did you visit the coast yesterday?
Eva: No, we visited a national park near a hill.
Dad: Did you walk up the hill?
Eva: The teacher changed that plan. We walked through the wood instead.
Dad: What did you do there?
Eva: We watched birds. I wanted to photograph them, but my camera was at home.
Dad: Did you stay until four?
Eva: No, it rained, so we returned at three.
Dad: Was the rain the worst part?
Eva: It was fine. The crowded bus was the only part I disliked. I had to stand for the whole journey.
